The following supplementary admission particulars are available for viewing:

Supplementary admission particulars dated 11 September 2026 (the "Supplement") supplementing the base admission particulars dated 13 November 2025 (together with the Supplement, the "Admission Particulars") relating to the £2,000,000,000 Euro Medium Term Note Programme established by Wise Financing plc, and guaranteed on a joint and several basis by Wise Group plc and certain subsidiaries of Wise Group plc.

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world's money.

With Wise Account and Wise Business, people and businesses can hold 40 currencies, move money between countries and spend money abroad. Large companies and banks use Wise technology too; an entirely new network for the world's money. Launched in 2011, Wise is one of the world's fastest growing, profitable tech companies.
In fiscal year 2026, Wise supported around 19 million people and businesses, processing over $240 billion in cross-border transactions and saving customers over $3 billion.
